parts.name: Root
parts.description: The chart. It makes a `<figure>`, holds the data and the scales, and controls the focus and the selection of the points.

props.name: id
props.description: A stable id, from which the component makes its internal ids. Give one on a server.

props.name: data
props.description: The rows. Each mark uses them when it has no `data` of its own.

props.name: x
props.description: The x channel: a field name of the row, or a function of the row.

props.name: y
props.description: The y channel: a field name of the row, or a function of the row.

props.name: series
props.description: The channel that divides the rows into series. Without it, the chart has one series.

props.name: xScale
props.description: The x scale.

props.name: yScale
props.description: The y scale.

props.name: width
props.description: The width of the SVG, in pixels. Without it, the chart follows the width of its container.

props.name: height
props.description: The height of the SVG, in pixels. The default is 300.

props.name: margin
props.description: The space around the plot, in pixels.

props.name: focused
props.description:
The point that has the focus, or `null`. You can bind it with `bind:focused`. The component
writes it; it does not read it.

props.name: selected
props.description:
The selected point, or `null`. You can bind it with `bind:selected`. `Enter`, `Space` or a
click selects a point, and a second time clears the selection. The selected point has
`aria-current="true"` and `data-selected`, and so has its cell in `Chart.DataTable`. The
selection follows the row index and the series of the point.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: The component calls it when the user activates a point with `Enter`, `Space` or a click.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale of the values in the names and the ticks. The default is the locale of the page.

props.name: xFormat
props.description:
The format of the x values in the accessible names and the ticks. Without it, a time scale
shows dates as precise as the data.

props.name: yFormat
props.description: The format of the y values in the accessible names and the ticks.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The accessible name of the chart, for when there is no `Chart.Title`.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: The id of the element that gives the chart its name.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: The id of the element that describes the chart, for example a summary of the trend.

props.name: children
props.description: The content: the title, the plot and the other parts.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the root element.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the root element.

props.name: context
props.description: A bindable reference to the context, for a composition of your own.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-within
dataAttributes.description: When a point of the chart has the focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: When the focused point shows the focus ring.

parts.name: Title
parts.description: The title. It makes a `<figcaption>`, and it gives the chart its accessible name.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the title.

parts.name: Plot
parts.description: The plot. It makes the `<svg>` that holds the marks and the guides, and it has the keyboard handlers.

props.name: children
props.description: The marks and the guides.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the SVG element.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the SVG element.

parts.name: ChartPoint
parts.description: A point, as `focused`, `selected` and `onSelect` give it.

props.name: datum
props.description: The row of the data.

props.name: index
props.description: The index of the row in the data of its mark.

props.name: series
props.description: The name of the series. It is empty when the chart has one series.

props.name: x
props.description: The value of the x channel.

props.name: y
props.description: The value of the y channel.
